name: diag_test_s16_s04_full_retry_plan_01
command:
"""One-off approved S04 full-retention retry plan; no submission or source repair."""
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
from src.tools import g01_quota_plan as quota
from src.tools import g01_ticket_bank as bank
from src.tools import gpu_shared_claim as shared
from src.tools import pbs_mixed_accounting as mixed
from src.envs import pair_v2_configuration as configurations

ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
NAME = 'diag_test_s16_s04_full_retry_plan_01'
OLD_NAME = 'gen_test_s16_round2_s04'
RUN = 'gen_test_s16_round2_s04_retry1'
JOB = '709455.hopper-m-02'
SCENES = ['FloorPlan325', 'FloorPlan425', 'FloorPlan26', 'FloorPlan226', 'FloorPlan326', 'FloorPlan426']

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)

def read(filename, sha):
    reference = {'file': filename, 'sha256': sha}
    return mixed.read_reference(ROOT, reference)[0], reference

def logged(filename, sha=None):
    ref = mixed.reference(ROOT / filename, ROOT)
    if sha is not None:
        require(ref['sha256'] == sha, 'Original logged source changed: ' + filename)
    data, _ = mixed.logged(ROOT, ref)
    return data, {**ref, 'metrics_sha256': data['_meta']['metrics_sha256']}

parent, pref = logged('results/' + OLD_NAME + '.json',
    'f3f9b23d90ce18130b9f541dfb9adf3ad7988634a607f37b5b016319d7cc3859')
account, aref = logged('results/diag_gen_test_s16_s04_accounting_01.json',
    '8e374b077775c3b9cdb5c95e38d674f4914a8441d25e7f08d19778d392cc401a')
require(parent['_meta']['exit_code'] == 1 and account['_meta']['exit_code'] == 0,
        'Preserve the actual failed parent and successful original canonical accounting')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s04_original_phase', ROOT / 'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py')
phase = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(phase)
final = phase._final_accounting(ROOT, {JOB}, paths=[ROOT / aref['file']])
require(JOB in final, 'Original S04 allocation has not ended canonically')
rows = [row for row in account['config']['jobs'] if row['job_id'] == JOB]
require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['qstat_exit'] == 0
        and rows[0]['fields']['job_state'] == 'F' and rows[0]['fields']['Exit_status'] == '1',
        'S04 retry requires the original F1 allocation, not an assumed missing process')
archive, archive_ref = read('logs/review/diag_test_s16_s04_unsealed_archive_01/manifest.json',
    'cda2a4a14929035384e1f14f338539eec8c4d770cd055434f7cc541393dd0980')
require(archive['allocation_ended_by_original_pbs'] is True and archive['original_records_modified'] is False
        and archive['parent']['sha256'] == pref['sha256']
        and archive['canonical_accounting']['sha256'] == aref['sha256'], 'Original lossless failure archive differs')

inventory, inventory_ref = logged('results/diag_current_test_selected_02.json',
    'c7e01a6baea4d2baca751d45e305e14e5fde8321fcf214c260284ed5e9960745')
report, report_ref = read('logs/review/diag_current_test_selected_02/report.json',
    '3abf987545fb711273779303663b43c4b771fa8bbaa0921a3e98bb89ae8b7427')
require(inventory['_meta']['exit_code'] == 0 and report_ref['sha256'] in
        (ROOT / inventory['_meta']['log_path']).read_text(), 'Selected inventory report lacks its original successful logged binding')
proof = report['proof']
require(proof['count_basis_authenticated'] is True
        and proof['count_basis_authority'] == 'g01_published_independent_checkpoint_receipt_v1'
        and proof['count_stage'] == 'independent_unique_construction_before_T02_filtering'
        and proof['outstanding_reservations'] == [], 'Not the approved original independent construction snapshot')
expected_checkpoints = {'results/t01v2_checkpoint_test_a_full_01.json',
    'results/t01v2_checkpoint_test_b_full_01.json',
    *{f'results/t01v2_checkpoint_test_s16_s{i:02d}_01.json' for i in (1, 2, 3)}}
require({r['file'] for r in proof['checkpoint_references']} == expected_checkpoints,
        'This preparation is bound to the approved A/B+S01/S02/S03 inventory cutoff')
require('Unsealed S04' in report['excluded'] and all(
    OLD_NAME not in row['source_reference']['file'] and OLD_NAME not in row['pair_reference']['file']
    for row in proof['unique_proposals']), 'Old S04 candidates already entered the published inventory; do not reallocate their ticket')

old, old_ref = read('configs/gen_test_s16_round2_s04_quota.json',
    'd7232a1856fdd65e74f2ec34cd7cad69b1a7803a1204131ef97452d5e2ffbfc6')
quota.validate_structure(old)
require(old['parent_run_name'] == OLD_NAME and old['partition'] == 'test'
        and [r['scene'] for r in old['assignments']] == SCENES
        and old['seed'] == 0 and old['field_of_view'] == 60, 'Original S04 scientific configuration differs')
latest_seen = configurations.validate_seen(proof['configuration_selection']['seen_configurations'])
original_seen = configurations.validate_seen(old['confirmed_configurations'])
def scene_occupancy(values):
    return sorted([row for row in values if row['configuration']['key']['scene'] in SCENES],
                  key=lambda row: (row['configuration']['configuration_id'], row['kind']))
require(scene_occupancy(latest_seen) == scene_occupancy(original_seen),
        'New accepted S04-scene configurations are missing from the original exclusion set; no unchanged retry may be emitted')

active, active_ref = shared.load_plan('configs/shared_test_priority_active_01.json',
    'a265edb569fc005af2abd4db28cfdcbdd3983cd0ef6af015365bd37a740dff2a', root=ROOT)
external = [row for row in active['external_reservations'] if row['unit']['name'] == OLD_NAME]
require(len(external) == 1 and shared.validate_external(external[0], ROOT) == JOB,
        'Original S04 external must remain bound to its actual original PBS job')
old_keys = set(external[0]['unit']['claim_keys'])
require(not any(old_keys.intersection(unit['claim_keys']) for unit in active['units']),
        'A runnable shared unit overlaps the preserved S04 reservation')
ticket_bank = bank.read_reference(external[0]['unit']['references']['g01_ticket_bank'], ROOT)
member = bank.expected_member(ticket_bank, external[0]['unit']['references']['g01_ticket_bank'], 's04', root=ROOT)
require(member['assignments'] == old['assignments'] and member['confirmed_configurations'] == old['confirmed_configurations'],
        'Standalone retry would change original disjoint S04 tickets')

storage, storage_ref = logged('results/diag_scratch_quota_compression_01.json')
require(storage['_meta']['command'] == ['python3', '-m', 'src.tools.record_command', '--name',
    'diag_scratch_quota_compression_01', '--', 'hpc', 'quota']
    and storage['config']['command'] == ['hpc', 'quota'], 'Use the original requested quota query, not a filesystem-wide free-space value')
quota_log = (ROOT / storage['_meta']['log_path']).read_text()
match = re.search(r'^\s*e1583364\s*\|\|\s*([0-9.]+)([GMT]B)\s*\|\s*([0-9.]+)([GMT]B)\s*\|\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|\s*(\w+)', quota_log, re.M)
require(match is not None, 'Original account scratch quota row is unavailable')
units_evidence, units_ref = logged('results/diag_current_storage_units_01.json')
require(units_evidence['_meta']['exit_code'] == 0, 'Original CLI unit interpretation evidence failed')
# The earlier logged CLI inspection established that hpc labels GB/TB using
# binary GiB/TiB values. Preserve its labels verbatim, but interpret them using
# that existing evidence rather than treating the display as decimal bytes.
scale = {'MB': 2**20, 'GB': 2**30, 'TB': 2**40}
used = float(match[1]) * scale[match[2]]; hard = float(match[3]) * scale[match[4]]
require(hard - used >= 150 * 10**9, 'Account scratch displayed headroom is below the approved 150GB stop line')
storage_guard = {'source': storage_ref, 'original_exit_code': storage['_meta']['exit_code'],
    'original_account_row': match.group(0).strip(), 'unit_interpretation_source': units_ref,
    'cli_display_unit_interpretation': 'GB=GiB, TB=TiB; original CLI labels retained',
    'displayed_used_bytes': used, 'displayed_hard_bytes': hard, 'displayed_headroom_bytes': hard-used,
    'minimum_headroom_bytes_decimal': 150*10**9,
    'scope': 'Original rounded account-quota snapshot, not a reserved or exact filesystem capacity guarantee; recheck before submission if stale'}

for folder in ('results', 'logs/runs'):
    require(not list((ROOT / folder).glob(RUN + '*')), 'New retry name already has evidence')
require(not list((ROOT / 'logs/pbs').glob(RUN + '-*'))
    and not (Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027/g01_parallel') / RUN).exists(), 'New retry already has a reservation/raw directory')
for path in (ROOT / 'logs/pbs').glob(OLD_NAME + '*-*/payload.json'):
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
    require(payload['name'] == OLD_NAME, 'Another S04 retry exists; coordinate its terminal state before creating a new attempt')
plan = copy.deepcopy(old); plan['parent_run_name'] = RUN
require({k:v for k,v in plan.items() if k!='parent_run_name'} == {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!='parent_run_name'},
        'Only engineering run identity may change')
quota.validate_structure(plan)
path = ROOT / 'configs' / (RUN + '_quota.json')
with path.open('xb') as stream:
    stream.write((json.dumps(plan,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode())
    stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
path.chmod(0o444)
new_ref = mixed.reference(path,ROOT)
command = ['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.g01_collect_parallel','--name',RUN,'--scenes',*SCENES,
    '--concurrency','6','--benchmark-source','results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json',
    '--timeout-seconds','1600','--partition','test','--quota-plan',new_ref['file'],
    '--quota-plan-sha256',new_ref['sha256'],'--nearby-physics']
expected = list(parent['_meta']['command'])
for flag,value in (('--name',RUN),('--quota-plan',new_ref['file']),('--quota-plan-sha256',new_ref['sha256'])):
    expected[expected.index(flag)+1]=value
require(command==expected and '--sample-rejected-raw' not in command,
        'Full-retention retry changed original generation arguments')
submission = ['python3','scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py','--task','T01','--budget-group','G01',
    '--name',RUN,'--gpus','1','--walltime','00:27:10','--',*command]
metrics = {'new_quota_plan':new_ref,'command':command,'submission_command':submission,
    'old_job_id':JOB,'old_failed_source':pref,'original_failed_evidence_archive':archive_ref,
    'selected_inventory_snapshot':report_ref,'same_scene_configurations_already_excluded':True,
    'original_shared_external_preserved':external[0],'unchanged_scientific_claim_keys':sorted(old_keys),
    'only_quota_field_changed':'parent_run_name','raw_retention':'original_full',
    'scene_timeout_seconds':1200,'parent_timeout_seconds':1600,'pbs_wall_seconds':1630,
    'storage_floor_guard':storage_guard,'gpu_submission_performed':False,
    'scope':'Approved79bc7426 engineering rerun of ended failed S04 on the same original tickets. No old unsealed candidate promoted, no additional quota, no modification of old queue/bank/source. Original per-process cleanup uncertainty retained.'}
result={'metrics':metrics,'config':{'name':NAME,'approved_task_commit':'79bc7426'},
    'sources':[pref,aref,inventory_ref,storage_ref,units_ref],
    'artifact_references':[old_ref,new_ref,archive_ref,report_ref,active_ref]}
with (ROOT/'results'/(NAME+'.json')).open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(result,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
